title: Runs of build results
hints: itertools.groupby(results, key=lambda r: r[1]) yields (status, group) for each run of adjacent equal statuses; it does not sort, which is what you want here.
Each group is an iterator you must consume before moving on: [build_id for build_id, _ in group] inside the loop or comprehension.
For the streak, filter the runs to status == "fail" and take max(runs, key=len, default=[]); max returns the first of equal-length candidates, which gives the earliest run.
